name: Deluin
author: coding agent draft (Claude, a closed model by Anthropic), approved by the owner

who.text: , one of four foreign contestants brought in to play in
. He tops the qualifiers, winning six games of six
. He laughs easily and likes to tease, and he and Zei quickly become friends

start.text: He sits down beside Zei at the tournament and says "Hi, I'm Deluin"
. In the semifinal against Kau he builds walls and simply fortifies, and wins
. Over tea he invites Zei home, shows him pictures of castles, pine forests and snow-topped red mountains, and jokes that he'll pay for the trip with his championship winnings

later.text: . He writes to Zei: "Don't worry, I am alive. Though it looks like I'm not going to be getting back to Dzego anytime soon."
Weeks later, a hidden letter reaches Zei: the Arctics have taken Redshire's devices, his parents have chosen to cooperate with them, and he will play along to win their trust
, though "I do not share their sympathies."
. His Minpentai record and his parents' standing make him one of the Arctic commanders
. In the war he secretly sends Zei tactics against the southern flank he controls
. Bai insists he prove himself first
, so he hands over access to the Arctic drones' simulated environment
. Afterwards he meets Zei, Bai and Mu on a snowy mountain in
, and hears there is basically no chance of getting Redshire back

drives.text: His friends and his home. He invites Zei to Redshire and shows him its castles, pine forests and red mountains
, and he believes even beautiful nature takes human work to maintain
